prompt:
Create ONE finished native editable SVG containing TWO closely related Hearth fantasy minion portraits: Coal Imp normal on the LEFT and Coal Imp Golden on the RIGHT. Canvas exactly 1600 by 560, viewBox="0 0 1600 560". Each scene is 800 by 560. Separate top-level groups id="imp-normal" and id="imp-golden"; translate the right group by (800,0). Each group has its own local dark forest-ink background rectangle and self-contained artwork. Generous quiet margins. No labels or dividing line.

Draw the SAME small bat-winged coal demon in expressive chest-up three-quarter portraits, cropped intentionally below the ribs. Preserve a strong demonic identity: short asymmetric curved horns, broad bat ears, a projecting short muzzle, deep cheek and brow planes, narrow intelligent amber eyes, two small fangs and organic neck/shoulder transitions. Natural mauve/plum skin, charcoal horns and bat wing membranes. This is an imp, not a green goblin, human child, skull or huge-eyed mascot. Use a few well-designed facial planes and connected curved contours; small board size requires a readable face and coal-bearing hand rather than a tiny full figure.

LEFT NORMAL: a compact guarded hunch, head tilted inquisitively, a mischievous restrained expression. One clawed hand cups a small warm coal near the chest. The near shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingers support it continuously, with simple but believable palm contact. Folded bat wings frame the shoulders quietly, with membranes meeting their bones rather than disconnected triangular ornaments. The other hand can be partly cropped and quiet. The face remains the focal point.

RIGHT GOLDEN: the same imp opens into a stronger presentation gesture. The near forearm extends the coal outward and slightly upward while the other hand supports it from beneath; both wrists and elbows fit the chest/shoulder turn. The head looks toward the coal with a sharper alert expression. One wing opens into a clear broad arc behind the shoulder, the other remains folded. This creates a distinct silhouette and action from normal without changing species or merely enlarging/recoloring the same portrait. The coal has restrained ivory/copper planes and a tiny warm reflected highlight, not a giant explosion or particle cloud.

STYLE: refined engraved fantasy illustration matching Hearth's existing natural-material family. Three broad value groups, upper-left light, expressive organic connected forms, sparse form-following cuts, quiet dark background. Palette: forest ink #172928, deep plum #493249, warm mauve #8a6474, facial highlight #b08794, pale warm ivory #dfd4b4, charcoal #292631, restrained copper #b97c5e and amber #d9aa68. Preserve plum/mauve flesh in both scenes; gold supports the action, not an all-gold demon. Keep materials tactile, faces asymmetric and convincing, and details readable at 160 by 112, 80 by 56 and 64 by 45. Avoid block-like limb pieces, floating hands, pasted-on faces, glossy plastic, dense tiny teeth and noisy repeated hatching.

Deliver static native SVG with editable paths and simple shapes. No raster images, scripts, external resources, text, numbers, card frames, statistics, logos, watermarks, badges or ornamental borders. Each complete scene must extract cleanly as an 800 by 560 image. Anatomy, expression, hand support and coherent silhouette take precedence over decoration.
